notes.title: Accessibility update
notes.content:
With this, I want to bring attention to the latest series of updates that King Boo has enjoyed: mostly centered around lowering the barrier of entry even further.

These latest updates were triggered by my own daughter (3yrs old) who is just starting to show interest in video games but struggling a little. Indeed she kept falling off the map and I was confronted with the fact that King Boo failed to deliver on its mission: to be an absolute easiest entry point into gaming for young gamers.

There are, for now, still places where the player can fall (at moving platforms or bridges) but 99% of all edges are now protected. Furthermore I happily borrowed a feature from my other game (Double Trouble) which are on-screen arrows that guide to the nearest pickup. I've had some feedback now and then that some of the bigger levels are too challenging and this should help players that have trouble finding their last pumpkin or whatever :D

Both of these features can be enabled/disabled from the pause menu which could be interesting for parents to try to push their child to try and beat the levels at some point with for instance fall protection disabled!

Lastly, various bugfixes and code improvements were installed. The latter especially should address some of the technical debt that had accumulated in this project from it being essentially a learning experience. I'm happy with the current state and it's giving me good confidence towards future updates.

I also want to thank everyone who has engaged with me in any way (since release, really). I love reading the reviews, I love hearing about how your little ones are having a good time!

Anyway, hope you all enjoy! Spread the news!

Kind regards,
Nicolas

notes.title: Candy Update is now live!
notes.content:
Hi all,

It is with great pleasure that I announce the release of King Boo version 2.1! Included with this update are more levels (now 3 small, 2 medium and 1 large map), candy theme for two of the levels and Steam achievements!

I really do hope you all have fun with this free update! Let me know your comments and feedback!

Kind regards,
Nicolas

notes.title: King Boo version 2.0 now out
notes.content:
First off, I want to thank all players for their support and kind words that I've received!

Avid players have noticed several small updates in the past weeks since release, and finally we're calling it 2.0. Major new features since launch include:

 A tutorial level - after feedback that some players found the main world overwhelming without gentle introduction.
 Flowers - Dirt is scattered throughout the world and with a magic touch, King Boo can grow beautiful flowers! Who doesn't like zen flower growing?
 The boat - a boat now connects two key locations in the world.
 Balloons!! - Feedback was given that some players found navigation quite difficult. Luckily now there are balloons around! When King Boo interacts with them, a bird's eye view of the surrounding area is revealed!

Anyway, I'm thrilled. Hope you all have fun and look forward to hearing your feedback and watching the playerbase grow! :)

notes.title: version 1.3 now live

As you explore, you'll now find spots where King Boo can grow flowers! And have you found the boat ride?

Full change list:
- added ability to turn music on/off
- refined the controls info screen in the main menu
- added flowers that the player can make grow
- added a boat ride

notes.title: Update: Releasing now!
notes.content:
It's official: King Boo will release, according to plan, on [strike]Oct 20[/strike] Oct 18! Additional features include:

Randomized item distribution/locations: each game will have items in different order and locations! Each playthrough is therefore different!
Chests now require keys to unlock.
Look out for the painter's tent where King Boo can get a new color.
Can you find your bat companion?

Have fun!
